     Context

     greet.js exports a single greet(name) helper via module.exports = { greet };. We want a matching farewell(name).

     Steps

       module.exports = { greet, farewell };.
     - Verify: node -e "console.log(require('./greet').farewell('Ada'))" should print Goodbye, Ada.
